verdicts.reason: The summary only names the 2002 paper 'Language Trees and Zipping' and never says it used gzip to cluster languages or that this estimates cross-entropy.

It calls cross-entropy 'a measure of the difference between two probability distributions' but does not give the bits-per-symbol definition with a code optimized for Q on data from P, or its asymmetry.
The summary never mentions that cross-entropy is minimized when Q equals P, that the minimum is the entropy of P, or KL divergence.
It only says cross-entropy is used 'to train models' and does not state the average negative log probability of the true next token or that the log is forced.
The summary does not mention distillation or training a small model against a larger model's distribution.
